items.lede: Following an October announcement, Apple has detailed new permission controls, warnings, and transparency features coming to macOS 27.3 to address risks posed by AI agents and other apps.
items.title: Apple reveals new Mac security controls as AI agents raise privacy risks

items.lede: After sounding an alarm about the issue, Apple is taking steps to limit Mac disk access to AI agents.
items.title: Apple adds new disk controls to prevent AI agents from running amok

items.lede: The messaging app similarly limited screenshots because of Microsoft Recall last year.
items.title: Signal to restrict screenshots over AI agent concerns – again

items.lede: It describes the fix as incomplete and calls for a simple way for developers to opt out of AI snooping.
items.title: Signal now blocks screenshots by default to stymie AI agents

items.lede: Apple, Google, and Microsoft called out for failing to provide developers with adequate AI agent controls
items.title: Signal slams door on prying AI agents to protect privacy
